description: One test run: its status, whether it has finished, its outcome, whether the test passed, its conversations and major and minor problems, how many messages it sent, any error that stopped it, its summary (the headline, conversations that could not be reviewed, turns the agent failed on, and the average of each quality score from 1 to 5), each conversation with its id and verdict (read one with get_conversation), and a link to it in the app. A run has finished once it is judged and its problems sorted.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

run_number.description: The run's number in its project, e.g. 24 for 'Run #24'.
run_number.title: Run Number

name: get_run
